notes.title: Maggie's Movies - Second Shot is available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, film buffs and game enthusiasts! 🎬✨[/h1]

We're excited to announce that Maggie's Movies - Second Shot is here! 🎥✨ Grab your popcorn, settle in, and dive into an all-new filmmaking adventure! 🎉🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37050918/a3795191f1bbf2015df3484e74877cea3192e6c9.gif[/img]

In this sequel, Maggie’s taking on her most ambitious shoot yet—a swashbuckling, high-stakes pirate blockbuster! 🏴‍☠️💣 But as any director knows, big budget Hollywood dreams can quickly spiral into chaos. Will you keep the production on track, rally the crew, and handle those inevitable set meltdowns? 🎬🔥 Can you guide Maggie’s film to box-office gold and maybe even some shiny awards? 🏆🎥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263630/Maggies_Movies__Second_Shot/

That’s all for now, folks—see you on set! 🎬🎉 [i]And... that’s a wrap![/i] 🎬🎤

notes.title: Maggie's Movies - Second Shot! Coming sooner than you might think!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, film buffs and game enthusiasts! 🎬✨[/h1]

It’s been a while since we first teased [i]Maggie’s Movies - Second Shot[/i], but the wait is almost over! After some behind-the-scenes work and a fresh new publisher stepping in, this project is nearly in the can! 🎥💥 We’re thrilled to say the grand premiere is just around the corner, and to make things even sweeter—drumroll—[b]a playable demo is dropping next week![/b] That’s right, you’ll be stepping onto the virtual set sooner than you think! 🎉🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37050918/a3795191f1bbf2015df3484e74877cea3192e6c9.gif[/img]

In this sequel, Maggie’s taking on her most ambitious shoot yet—a swashbuckling, high-stakes pirate blockbuster! 🏴‍☠️💣 But as any director knows, big budget Hollywood dreams can quickly spiral into chaos. Will you keep the production on track, rally the crew, and handle those inevitable set meltdowns? 🎬🔥 Can you guide Maggie’s film to box-office gold and maybe even some shiny awards? 🏆🎥

Just a smidge more patience and all will be revealed! Stay tuned for updates on the official release, and [b]don’t forget to wishlist Maggie’s Movies - Second Shot[/b]! 🌟 And of course, be sure to check out the demo when it drops next week. 🎮💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263630/Maggies_Movies__Second_Shot/

That’s all for now, folks—see you on set! 🎬🎉 [i]And... that’s a wrap![/i] 🎬🎤
